subject: Plan: MedForge private-hosting ops review — calendar options
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Voss <elena.voss@medforge.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@medforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Post-call recap + next step: private-hosting ops review

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand MedForge's security posture and the primary constraints for private hosting (data residency, strict egress controls, and an internal change-control window). Quick recap and proposed next step: 

Summary from today's discovery
- Primary workload: PHI ingestion + inference for triage models (~10 qps peak, 8k token context).
- Must run inside customer VPC with no public egress; KMS integration required.
- Expected concurrency: initial pilot ~4 concurrent sessions, ramping to 30 in production.
- Success criteria for pilot: 99% availability during business hours, <150ms median token latency for 512-token context on typical prompts.

Recommended next step
We recommend a 90-minute architecture review/ops walkthrough with your infra and security teams so we can:
1) validate VPC topology and firewall rules
2) align on KMS/HSM options and key usage patterns
3) go over deployment automation and audit logs (what we can expose)
4) confirm rollout / rollback plan and SLA expectations

Proposed attendees (please add anyone from your infra/security team):
- From Redwood: Connor O'Brien (solutions lead), Marissa Cole (platform engineer), Rishi Malhotra (ops architect)
- From MedForge: Elena Voss (Head of Security), Tom Hayes (CISO or proxy) + network owner

Available 90-minute windows next week (all times ET):
- Wed 24 May, 16:00–17:30 ET
- Thu 25 May, 10:00–11:30 ET
- Thu 25 May, 15:00–16:30 ET

Attachments: I attached a short requirements worksheet (medforge-priv-hosting-requirements.xlsx) and a draft network topology image that we sketched during the call (medforge-network-topology-draft.png). If you can share your existing network diagram or any firewall/NGFW ACLs ahead of the review that would speed things up.

If none of the slots work, tell me two times that do and we'll accommodate. I can send a calendar invite for the selected window.

Thanks — Connor
--
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Lead, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0183

Connor —

Appreciate the clear recap and the worksheet — that helps a lot. Tom is looping in our lead network engineer (CC'd) who will need to be present. Of the times you proposed, Wed 24 May 16:00–17:30 ET works best for our team.

Before the call, two quick asks:
1) Can you put together a short agenda (30/45 minute technical deep-dive + 30/45 minute ops/runbook discussion) so we can block the right folks?
2) We have a SOC 2 questionnaire in progress; can you confirm what audit evidence Redwood can provide ahead of the pilot? A simple checklist would be great.

We'll send a calendar hold for Wed 24 May 16:00 ET once you confirm the invite. Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Elena Voss
Head of Security, MedForge
elena.voss@medforge.com | +1 617 555 0124
